name: translate
description: Translate the cheminfo sites in place, and send the edits as a pull request
author: Luc Patiny

scripts.check-types: npm run check-types -w backend && npm run check-types -w frontend
scripts.dev: lsof -ti:10914,10915 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test-only && npm run check-types && npm run check-tokens && npm run check-deploy && npm run eslint && npm run prettier
scripts.test-only: npm run test-only -w backend && npm run test-only -w frontend
